messages:
maya: Heads-up — premerge eval for summarizer v2.1 (rc/47) shows a -1.9% mean quality delta vs stable v2.0 on the help-center suite. I'm pausing the change window until we triage.

jordan: linked run https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/4532 — looks like the drop is concentrated in short-faq and howto buckets.

deploy-bot: preflight-eval result: mean_quality_delta = -1.9% (threshold -1.0%). failing buckets: help-center.short-faq, help-center.howto. logs: /var/logs/eval/4532.log

tia: Proposal: sample 500 *fresh* unseen examples from the production help-center backlog and run targeted evals. If drift < 0.8% we can consider a limited canary (EU-only, 10%). If not, keep HOLD.

maya: +1 to fresh sampling. Product needs to sign off on any canary. @jordan please own bisect and the external 500-sample run.

jordan: created RW-5732 and starting git bisect now. Will post updates.

qa-bot: Scheduled sample run: command to execute:
``
redwood eval run --suite help-center --samples 500 --model summarizer:v2.1 --seed 20260320
```
Posting results here when complete.

release-bot: Change window: PAUSED. Blocker: premerge-eval-failure. Resume requires eng + product signoff or `release-approve` reaction from product lead.

sam: If bisect is noisy, fallback plan: staged canary — 2% for 30m then 10% for 3h with auto-rollback if sampled delta > 0.8%. I can schedule if we need it.

maya: I prefer to avoid prod exposure until we know the root cause. HOLD for now.

jordan: Bisect narrowed the regression to commit a7c3f2 — that commit adjusts the summarizer quant profile (reduced FP16 range). Rolling that change back locally and re-running the 500-sample.

jordan: Quick local check after reverting quant profile shows delta -> -0.2% (within threshold). Re-running full 500-sample to confirm before any action.

tia: If confirmed, we should cut a hotfix PR that reverts the quant-profile tweak, queue it for expedited review, then run a small canary to validate. I will draft the minimal release note explaining that we reverted a tuning change causing minor output regressions in help-center summaries.

maya: Jordan, record the exact commands and minimal repro steps in RW-5732 and include the diff so the hotfix PR is straightforward. Also include a short runbook entry for on-call in case similar regressions appear.

jordan: Commands/diff will be posted to RW-5732. Minimal revert steps used locally:
``
git checkout a7c3f2~1 -- models/summarizer/quant_profiles/default.json
# build + eval
redwood build --model summarizer:v2.1 && redwood eval run --suite help-center --samples 500 --model summarizer:v2.1
```

sam: :thumbsup: I can pre-schedule the 2% canary window as a fallback (10:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow) if we need it.

release-bot: Note: hotfix window can be auto-scheduled for 10:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow to minimize global impact if PR is ready.

maya: STATUS = HOLD. Next update after jordan posts full 500-sample results and attaches the revert diff in RW-5732. Thanks all.
